title: Po, the Kung Fu Panda.
lines: In a village in China, among high mountains, lives a panda.
His name is Po.
Po is big and round.
He works in his dad's noodle restaurant.
His dad is a goose.
Po loves noodles.
He loves dumplings.
But most of all he loves kung fu.
Kung fu is a martial art.
You learn to be strong, to be fast and to stay calm.
At the top of the mountain lives Master Shifu.
He is a small red panda.
He teaches the best kung fu to five heroes.
Tigress, Monkey, Crane, Viper and Mantis.
One day there's a big celebration.
The wise old tortoise is going to choose the Dragon Warrior.
The very strongest hero.
Po really wants to watch.
He runs up the mountain.
A thousand steps!
He huffs and puffs.
When he gets to the top, the gate is closed.
Po ties fireworks to a chair.
He lights them.
Boom!
He flies up into the air.
Po lands with a thump.
Right in front of the tortoise.
The tortoise points at him.
You are the Dragon Warrior.
Everyone is amazed.
A panda?
He can't even touch his toes!
Master Shifu doesn't want to teach Po.
But Po doesn't give up.
Every day he falls over.
And every day he gets up again.
Then Shifu notices something.
When there's food around, Po gets really fast.
He climbs high to grab a cookie.
He jumps really far for a dumpling.
Shifu laughs.
Now I know how to teach you.
He uses dumplings to train Po.
Po learns to jump.
He learns to spin.
He learns to be fast.
Then an angry snow leopard comes.
His name is Tai Lung.
He wants to rule the village.
Po stands in front of the village.
Tai Lung strikes.
But Po is soft and round.
Everything bounces back.
Boing!
With a clever grip of his little finger, Po stops the snow leopard.
Tai Lung flies away and never comes back.
The whole village cheers.
Po is the real Dragon Warrior.
His dad gives him a bowl of noodles.
The secret ingredient, says Dad, is that there is no secret.
You just have to believe in yourself.
The end.
